{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS070 |prevtitle=Allied by Alazakam! |nextcode=PS072 |nexttitle=Weezing Winks Out |series=Yellow |colorscheme=Yellow}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Muk Raking |title_ja=VSベトベトン |title_ro=VS Betbeton |image=PS071.png |scheme=Yellow |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 71 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|6}} |pub2=VIZ Media monthly issue |pub2-data=Chapter 31 in [[Agatha's Arbok]] |pub3=VIZ Media full volume |pub3-data=Adventure 71 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|6}} |location=[[Cerise Island]] }} '''Muk Raking''' (Japanese: '''VSベトベトン''' ''VS {{tt|Betbeton|Muk}}'') is the 71st chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 31st chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} [[Koga]] tells his {{TP|Koga|Golbat}} to use {{m|Supersonic}} to find their enemy. With the enemy's location known, Koga draws the {{p|Arbok}} out of hiding and sends out his Arbok. The battle is now {{p|Arbok}} vs. Arbok. Agatha's Arbok starts with a {{m|Leer}}, lowering Koga's Arbok's defenses, but Koga's {{p|Golbat}} undoes Leer with a thick {{m|Haze}}. Agatha's Arbok lets loose with a {{m|Rock Slide}} that rains stalactites, which makes that part of the cave a stalactite maze, and separates Koga and {{adv|Blue}}. [[Agatha's Gengar]] uses a quick {{m|Lick}} that {{status|paralysis|paralyzes}} his eyes shut. So Blue tries having Golbat use Supersonic to find Agatha and Koga. But Supersonic fails when another Golbat destroys their sound wave with its own Supersonic. And this Golbat is quick to attack. Agatha appears in front of Koga and wants to show him that her {{pkmn|battle}} skills are better than his. First she uses mist to change the pattern on her Arbok's skin and explains that each pattern brings a rare trait. Its current pattern gives it a great {{stat|speed}} boost. Agatha then changes the pattern to one that multiplies Arbok's {{stat|attack}} power, and it {{m|wrap}}s around Koga and his Arbok, making them helplessly immobilized. ==Major events== * [[Koga]] and {{adv|Blue}} fight against [[Agatha]]. * Koga and Blue are separated. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Blue}} * [[Koga]] * [[Agatha]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Golduck}} ({{OP|Blue|Golduck}}) * {{p|Golbat}} ({{OP|Koga|Golbat}}) * {{p|Arbok}} ([[Koga]]'s) * {{p|Muk}} ([[Koga]]'s) * {{p|Arbok}} ([[Agatha]]'s) * {{p|Gengar}} ({{OP|Agatha|Gengar}}) * {{p|Golbat}} ([[Agatha]]'s) ==Trivia== * The title comes from {{wp|muckraker}}, groups of people during the late 19th and early 20th centuries who sought to expose corruption in the US government. ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{yellow color light}}|bordercolor={{yellow color}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 臭臭泥|VS Muk}} |cs=Vs.
